title: Mr. D's signal discovery for locating UAP; government radar saw them but did not tell Skywatcher

tellings.quote: And Mr. D. found out, what can we do to pick up signals from these devices, to determine their geolocation or direction in the sky, and

plain: A man known only as Mr. D found a way to pick up signals from unexplained flying objects, or UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs), so that their position or direction in the sky could be worked out, and government radar also saw these objects but did not tell the team. James Valor, who works with Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon such objects, tells Michels this from inside the work between 2021 and 2025. If true, it would mean the objects can be tracked on purpose and that officials were watching without sharing.
